answer.reason: The verses say Gad built Dibon and that the spoiler of Moab would destroy its strong holds, which adds to the summary.

clauses.english: was built by the children of Gad
clauses.quote: the children of Gad built Dibon

clauses.english: was warned that the spoiler of Moab would destroy its strong holds
clauses.quote: he shall destroy thy strong holds

doubts: NUM 33:45-46 name Dibongad, an Israelite camp, which may be a different place, so I left those verses out.
The other verses only list Dibon among cities or boundaries (NUM 32:3, JOS 13:9, JOS 13:17), name it in a lament (ISA 15:2) or in a list of places judged (JER 48:22), and add nothing as events.
The clause from JER 48:18 reports a prophecy of destruction, not a completed event.
